issues.title: Console error when opening the Settings dialog
issues.description: Opening Settings logs an uncaught TypeError and the dialog's Apply button stops responding.
issues.expected: Settings opens with no console errors and every control works.
issues.actual: An uncaught TypeError is logged and Apply does nothing until the page is reloaded.
issues.suggestion: Reopen Settings after reloading the page. Until this is fixed, change preferences the other way: edit the graph name in the top bar, which still works.
console: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'theme') at SettingsDialog.tsx:142

issues.title: Fillet node label is clipped in the task flow
issues.description: After inserting the fillet node during the cylinder task, its title is cut off and its output socket cannot be connected.
issues.expected: The fillet node's full name is visible and its output socket connects like other nodes.
issues.actual: The title is clipped mid-word and dragging from the output socket does nothing.
steps: Run the Make a filleted cylinder task
Try to drag a connection from its output socket
issues.suggestion: Reload the page and add the fillet node again from the Add-node palette (Shift+A), then connect it immediately. If the socket still will not connect, rename the node by double-clicking its title — renamed nodes connect normally.

issues.title: Long node names overflow the node card
issues.description: Node titles longer than the card width run past the card edge instead of wrapping or truncating with an ellipsis.
issues.expected: Long node names are truncated with an ellipsis inside the card.
issues.actual: The text overflows the card border and overlaps the socket area.
steps: Rename any node to a long name
Look at the node card header
issues.suggestion: Keep node names short (under ~20 characters). If a name is too long, hover it to read the full name in the tooltip.

issues.title: Group button has no accessible name
issues.description: The Create group toolbar button is icon-only with no text, aria-label, or title, so screen readers announce nothing.
issues.expected: Every toolbar button has an accessible name.
issues.actual: The Create group button has no accessible name.
steps: Move focus to the toolbar with Tab
Check what the screen reader announces for Create group
issues.suggestion: Use the keyboard shortcut Ctrl+G to create a group instead of the toolbar button.
